text:
I will go, when evening sings, blue, in summer,

wounded by wheat, to tread the meadow;

dreamer, I will feel its coolness on my soles

and let the wind bathe my head.


Without speaking, without thinking, I will go along the paths:

but limitless love will grow in my soul.

I will go far away, happy, as with a girl,

through the fields, as far as the gypsy wanders.

translation.title: Sensation
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the summer walking vision and the limitless love growing in silence.
